summary: Scoold is a self-hosted question-and-answer platform structured similarly to Stack Overflow. It provides an enterprise-ready environment featuring full-text search, SAML and LDAP integration, and social login capabilities.
goodFor: It is well-suited for organisations needing an internal or community-facing knowledge base with enterprise authentication requirements.
watchOut: Adoption might be lower than mainstream alternatives, and customisation depends on familiarity with its specific Java stack.
deployNotes: As a Java application containerised for Docker and Kubernetes, you will typically need to configure persistent storage for user data and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
